# patch

Apply unified and context patches for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/patch@0.2.4 [OPTION]... [ORIGINALFILE [PATCHFILE]]
```

## Supported scope

Check patches with offsets, fuzz and reversal. Supports creating/deleting files and writing patched existing-file content to stdout.

## Options

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-p` / `--strip` | required | remove N leading file-name components |
| `-i` / `--input` | required | read the patch from FILE instead of stdin |
| `-o` / `--output` | required | write patched files to stdout |
| `-r` / `--reject-file` | required | write rejected hunks to a new FILE; - discards |
| `-d` / `--directory` | required | resolve target paths relative to DIR Default: `.`. |
| `-R` / `--reverse` | none | apply additions as removals and vice versa |
| `--dry-run` | none | check without writing or deleting files |
| `-s` / `--quiet` | none | suppress routine file messages |
| `-u` / `--unified` | none | require unified input |
| `-c` / `--context` | none | require context input |
| `-t` / `--batch` | none | select a detected reverse without prompting |
| `-F` / `--fuzz` | required | ignore up to N outer context lines (default 2) Default: `2`. |
| `--no-backup-if-mismatch` | none | accept the no-backup strict profile |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Limitations

- Updating existing pathnames and named -o output are rejected; use --dry-run or -o -.
- Binary/mode/rename patches, backups and interactive reversal prompts are unsupported. Existing reject files are never overwritten.
- Exit 1 for rejected hunks and 2 for malformed, unsupported or fatal requests.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/patch@0.2.4 --dry-run -i change.diff
moonx cli/patch@0.2.4 -o - -i change.diff original.txt
```
